objects.description: [CanisterWorm](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9042) has checked the target system's timezone `(/etc/timezone, timedatectl)` for `Asia/Tehran` or `Iran` and the `LANG` environment variable for `fa_IR` to identify systems matching an Iranian locale prior to deploying its destructive wiper component.(Citation: Palo Alto TeamPCP MAR 2026)(Citation: Aikido CanisterWorm MAR 2026)
